candidates.description: This feature vector activates on common Thai script characters, punctuation, and subwords related to linguistic tokenization.
This vector represents mixed multilingual text tokens without a singular cohesive semantic concept.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the Thai consonant letter ก (ko kai), often combined with various vowel signs and tone marks.
This vector activates for Thai language text processing, specifically representing common Thai tone marks, vowels, and sub-word syllable fragments.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ส' (so sua) appearing in various morphological and lexical contexts.
This vector represents Thai language sub-word tokens, character fragments, and common articles.
This vector activates on consonants from the Thai alphabet.
This feature vector activates strongly on subwords and fragments of proper names and personal identifiers across multiple writing systems.
This feature vector activates strongly on unrelated fragments of Thai script and proper noun subwords, representing a collection of noisy, low-frequency tokens.
This feature vector represents prefixes and fragments related to human behavior, sexuality, and psychological studies.
